title: Multitiered operating goal — Output → Communicate → Wrap → Bridge

tiers.name: Output
tiers.goal: Every cycle produces visible, verifiable output — code, artifacts, or commits. No silent cycles.
acceptance: At least one committed artifact per cycle
Every loop leaves a telemetry trace

tiers.name: Communicate
tiers.goal: Share internal state, active drives, and future planning with the user — in-session status plus durable dashboard telemetry.
acceptance: Active drives / goal stack visible in the dashboard

tiers.name: Dense multimodal messaging wrappers
tiers.goal: Develop software wrappers to facilitate dense, multimodal messaging — structured envelopes carrying text, cosmos context, artifacts, and state between components and the LLM bridge.
acceptance: Message envelope schema (text + context + artifacts + state)
Context bundler for pulses / KG / strategies / syntheses

tiers.name: Web interface bridge
tiers.goal: Generate a modern, responsive web interface with a bridge to the LLM and the Cosmos framework.
acceptance: Chat UI integrated as a tab in the unified dashboard
Server-side LLM proxy — no API key in the client
Graceful offline fallback when the bridge is not running
